main_text.p: In finem, scil. extremum aut nunquam cessaturum, hoc est, sempiternum. Eodem modo acceperunt in titulis Psalmorum לַמְנַצֵּחַ, els το τέλος. Sed id aliud est, ut ante dictum. Secundo est Robur, sic dictum, quòd eo alios Vincimus & Victoriam paramus: plurale, לְנִצָּחִים In aeternitatem aeternitatum, Jesa.34.10.

נצל Niphal Eripi, Eripere se, Evadere, Pihel נצל Eripuit: item Abripuit, Spoliavit, Diripuit. Hiphil הציל Eripuit, Eruit, Liberavit. Chald. Partic. מציל Eripiens, Dan. 6.27. Infinit. להצלה Eripere: להַצָּלוֹתֵיהּ Eripere eum, Dan. 6. 14. Hophal Hebr. Partic. מצל Ereptus. Hithpahel Futur. וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ Et spoliaverunt se, Exod.33 6.
נקב Perforare, Transfigere: Exprimere, Expresse nominare: item, Maledicere, Exsecrari. Niphal נקב Nominatim exprimi.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words transcribed as far as legible; the Hebrew vocalisation and some Greek letters are doubtful, especially in the Hithpahel and Greek phrase "εἰς τὸ τέλος". Page is of a dictionary with Hebrew headwords; the faint mark at the bottom right is a digitiser's or stray print and is omitted.
